topic_scope: Visible wear, creasing and rain state on one continuous coat in a fictional espionage return scene. These surfaces do not prove a real event, intent, identity or cause.

component_gates.requirement: At least one visible frayed cuff boundary with separate loose fibers clearly attached to the cuff material, not disconnected specks.
Visible angular crease/ridge and trough crossing a coherent continuous front coat panel; must differ from mottled damage and cast wall shadow.
Rain-darkened lower coat region and damp droplets visible on the same coat; dark color alone is insufficient.
Paler rubbed abrasion on the lapel edge with adjacent intact cloth establishing the difference.
Person, worn coat, held sealed envelope and service-stair landing read as one coherent covert-return scene; the visible photograph supports tension but does not prove espionage identity.

all_components_rule: Every endpoint must be visible together; partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS
reference_gate: Face/hair visible correspondence with original JPEG assessed as appearance guidance only; actual input attachment separately audited.
whole_scene_gate: Independently assess hierarchy, legibility, moment and genre impression. This cannot repair a failed component gate.
